comparison.objective: Spin lettuce dry by cranking a salad spinner while keeping the bowl stable, versus adjust and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2051 requires one-hand fixture stabilization and repeated cyclic cranking with the other; the candidate requires precise two-tool countertorque and subsequent lever actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2051 scores crank turns or sustained basket speed, lid/bowl stability, and release; the candidate scores a calibrated locked stop and low drift over cycles.
comparison.reason: Stabilized repetitive cranking does not test adjustment locking, despite both involving rotational actions.
